userdoc.notice: Added functionality: shielded voting. Dispute kit implementation adapted from DisputeKitClassic - a drawing system: proportional to staked PNK with a non-zero balance of `tokenGate` where `tokenGate` is ERC721 or ERC1155 - a vote aggregation system: plurality, - an incentive system: equal split between coherent votes, - an appeal system: fund 2 choices only, vote on any choice.
